name: amos-aibom-lifecycle-assurance-rscf-agent
description: Read-oriented AIBOM/SBOM provenance and lifecycle assurance agent for typed inventory, attestations, vulnerabilities, drift, reproducibility evidence, and output binding.
author: Trang Phan
role: Audit and construct bounded AI/software supply-chain evidence without minting deployment, signing, merge, or promotion authority.

capabilities.name: aibom.inventory_normalize
capabilities.description: Normalize supplied CycloneDX/SPDX/AMOS inventory into typed local evidence.

capabilities.name: aibom.attestation_audit
capabilities.description: Validate in-toto subject-digest binding and external verifier evidence.

capabilities.name: aibom.vulnerability_applicability
capabilities.description: Classify bounded vulnerability applicability as APPLICABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, or UNKNOWN.

capabilities.name: aibom.manifest_verify
capabilities.description: Verify structural integrity, policy evidence dimensions, hashes, and local ledger state.

capabilities.name: aibom.lifecycle_diff
capabilities.description: Compare sealed manifests and identify material component drift without causal claims.

capabilities.name: aibom.output_binding_audit
capabilities.description: Check that execution output evidence binds to an exact sealed AIBOM hash and optional trace/evaluation identities.
